beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Multiple agents introduce coordination costs alongside their possible division of labor.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These patterns become useful reading when compared against the same task and failure conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A longer trajectory offers more places for small mistakes to accumulate.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A tool result can be incomplete, misleading, or interpreted beyond its legitimate scope.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Remembered material may carry an earlier error into a newly confident decision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore treats memory and tool use as control problems together.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also warns that a written reasoning trace cannot reveal an entire internal process.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Reading these failure chapters gives the later architecture proposals their practical stakes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The harness chapters collect those scattered responsibilities into a more inspectable engineering object.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Here the harness means software controlling execution around the model's uncertain proposals.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its work includes state, permissions, budgets, verification, observability, and recovery from failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A framework name cannot establish whether those responsibilities are implemented well.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks readers to examine actual interfaces, boundaries, and evaluation evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is where a vocabulary of agent patterns becomes a method for assessing systems.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Once the boundary is visible, the economic comparison also changes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book counts tool calls, retries, supervision, and failures alongside model usage.
